# Crownwing Parrots

> UK parrot breeder and retailer. Individual birds and prices are confirmed by enquiry.

This optional text directory complements the public website. Cite the canonical HTML URLs; these exports are not additional stock listings.

## Species and care

[Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrot-care.md)
- [Parrot species UK | Explore eight groups | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/): Explore African Grey Parrots, macaws, cockatoos, Amazons, conures, caiques, Eclectus and parakeets. Compare lifespan, diet and daily care. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots.md)
- [African Grey Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/african-parrots/): Congo and Timneh African Grey Parrots are sensitive, intelligent companions with distinct needs. Communication brings enrichment, not a promise to talk. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--african-parrots.md)
- [Congo African Grey Parrot: Care, Character and Ownership | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/african-parrots/congo-african-grey-parrot/): Learn about Congo African Grey temperament, talking, size, diet, enrichment and long-term care before enquiring about current availability. - [Timneh Parrot: Personality, Size and Care Guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/african-parrots/timneh-parrot/): Explore the Timneh Parrot’s appearance, social needs, vocalisation, training and everyday care before asking about availability. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--african-parrots--timneh-parrot.md)
- [Amazon Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/amazons/): Amazon parrots are vocal. Steady routines support social needs. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--amazons.md)
- [Blue-fronted Amazon Parrot: Care and Character | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/amazons/blue-fronted-amazon-parrot/): Learn about the Blue-fronted Amazon’s appearance, vocalisation, temperament, training and practical daily care. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--amazons--blue-fronted-amazon-parrot.md)
- [Yellow-naped Amazon Parrot: Voice and Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/amazons/yellow-naped-amazon-parrot/): Explore Yellow-naped Amazon personality, size, vocal behaviour, training, housing and long-term care needs. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--amazons--yellow-naped-amazon-parrot.md)
- [Caique Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/caiques/): Caiques are compact, high-energy parrots that thrive on supervised activity. Their curiosity calls for structure, boundaries and daily enrichment. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--caiques.md)
- [Black-headed Caique: Energy, Play and Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/caiques/black-headed-caique/): Explore Black-headed Caique appearance, lively behaviour, training, housing and daily enrichment requirements. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--caiques--black-headed-caique.md)
- [White-bellied Caique: Personality and Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/caiques/white-bellied-caique/): A species guide to White-bellied Caique size, social life, enrichment, diet, training and safe daily activity. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--caiques--white-bellied-caique.md)
- [Cockatoo Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/cockatoos/): Cockatoos are intensely social parrots. Species differences affect size, noise and household fit. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--cockatoos.md)
- [Galah Cockatoo: Temperament, Size and Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/cockatoos/galah-cockatoo/): Discover what daily life with a Galah Cockatoo involves, including noise, companionship, enrichment, diet and housing. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--cockatoos--galah-cockatoo.md)
- [Umbrella Cockatoo: Social Needs and Care Guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/cockatoos/umbrella-cockatoo/): Read about Umbrella Cockatoo behaviour, powerful calls, housing, enrichment and long-term ownership responsibilities. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--cockatoos--umbrella-cockatoo.md)
- [Conure Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/conures/): Conures are active small parrots, but species differ in voice and size. Plan for daily play, social contact and lively calls. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--conures.md)
- [Green-cheeked Conure: Personality and Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/conures/green-cheeked-conure/): A guide to Green-cheeked Conure size, social behaviour, vocalisation, diet, training and enrichment. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--conures--green-cheeked-conure.md)

[Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--conures--sun-conure.md)
- [Eclectus Parrots: Size, Personality & Care | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/eclectus/): Eclectus parrots stand out for male and female plumage differences. Individual social preferences and a considered feeding routine matter just as much. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--eclectus.md)

- [Scarlet Macaw: A Guide to Care and Ownership | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/parrots/macaws/scarlet-macaw/): Understand Scarlet Macaw appearance, adult size, calls, social needs, training and the practicalities of long-term care. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/parrots--macaws--scarlet-macaw.md)

## Buyer guides
- [UK Parrot Guides | Buying, Care & Documentation | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/): A practical UK parrot resource library: choose a bird, check documentation, plan costs and prepare a safe home before making a buying enquiry. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides.md)
- [Buying a parrot in the UK: questions to ask | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/buying-a-parrot-checklist/): Use specific questions to understand the individual bird and the proposed purchase before agreeing to a handover. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--buying-a-parrot-checklist.md)
- [How to Buy a Parrot in the UK | Complete Buyer's Guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/buying-a-parrot/): Follow a UK parrot buying journey: household suitability, fully weaned birds, seller questions, documentation, budgets, transport and the first week at home. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--buying-a-parrot.md)
- [Which Parrot Is Right for Me? | UK Comparison Guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/choosing-a-parrot/): Compare eight parrot groups by size, noise, talking, social needs, lifespan and household demands. Build a thoughtful shortlist, not a best-bird ranking. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--choosing-a-parrot.md)
- [Parrot Documentation UK | CITES & Bird Registration | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/cites-parrots-uk/): Check what UK parrot buyers should ask about CITES, identification, lawful origin, bird registration and GB/NI movements, with dated official sources. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--cites-parrots-uk.md)
- [Parrot diet and nutrition | Feeding guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/parrot-diet-nutrition/): Understand the feeding questions to discuss before choosing food or changing your bird’s routine. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--parrot-diet-nutrition.md)
- [Parrot housing and enrichment | Home guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/parrot-housing-enrichment/): Plan accommodation, safe exercise and daily activities around the individual bird. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--parrot-housing-enrichment.md)
- [Cost of Keeping a Parrot UK | Budget Planner | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/parrot-ownership-costs/): Plan the cost of keeping a parrot in the UK with a quote-based budget calculator covering setup, food, toys, veterinary saving, insurance and an emergency reserve. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--parrot-ownership-costs.md)
- [Preparing for a new parrot | First-week guide | Crownwing Parrots](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/guides/preparing-for-a-parrot/): Prepare the space, understand the existing routine and leave room for a gradual adjustment. [Text version](https://crownwingparrots.co.uk/ai-pages/guides--preparing-for-a-parrot.md)
